summary: Unexpected 'warmstart' invoice line + reserved-rate discount not applied after hybrid fallback during region maintenance
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports an unexpected invoice line labelled 'warmstart-probe-tokens' for 2026-02-28 which appears to be billed at hosted rates rather than their committed reserved rate. Impact: Invoice shows a $2,438.70 line; customer requests explanation and either credit or reapplication of reserved-rate discount. Environment: BrightCart's org migrated to Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) on 2026-02-24; a cross-region maintenance window and a partial fallback to hosted occurred 2026-02-28 02:00-03:30 UTC. Timeline: 2026-02-24 dedicated activation; 2026-02-28 maintenance-induced fallback; invoice finalized 2026-03-01.

Observed behavior: Invoice line 'warmstart-probe-tokens (us-east-1)' with quantity 12,150 tokens, billed at hosted rate. Reserved capacity discount not applied. Customer says these were service warmup probes tied to their reserved pool and should have been covered by reserved allowance.

Expected behavior: Warmup / KV cache warmstart traffic originating from the customer's dedicated pool should be charged to reserved capacity (no extra hosted line) or be credited as part of the reserved warmup buffer.

Customer-provided artifacts: PDF invoice pages 3-4 (attached), sample postback id: pb_20260228_2491, last 4 of API key tag: -3X7L, timestamps in customer app logs: 2026-02-28T02:05:12Z -> 2026-02-28T02:06:45Z.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate dedicated->hosted fallback by forcing reserved pool overload (internal repro only). 2) Trigger model rollout that causes KV cache warmup on fallback path (canary then overflow). 3) Observe postbacks labeled as 'probe' or 'warmup' get tagged with hosted tariff when routed to hosted pool. 4) Verify rate application in billing reconcile service (billing-rate-lookup).
logs_and_evidence: Invoice line id: INV-20260301-BC-0043, line desc: 'warmstart-probe-tokens (us-east-1)', amount: 2438.70 USD, qty: 12150 tokens, unit_price: 0.2005 USD/token. Postback id pb_20260228_2491 shows routing: fallback->hosted-edge-03, routing metadata: {route_policy: 'fallback', original_pool: 'dedicated-bc-pool-9'}. Billing reconciler logs (billing-reconciler-2026-02-28.log) show rate_cache_refresh at 2026-02-27T23:58:01Z and rate_override_lookup returned NULL for contract id BC-RES-2026. See SRE trace: trace_id trc-8812-warmup.
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (Support): Verified invoice line and postback id match customer's artifacts. Noted that postbacks during fallback were routed to hosted and carried tag 'probe'. Engineering hypothesis: 'probe' warmup traffic was not mapped to reserved contract in the billing-lookup path because route metadata lost the org_contract_id during cross-region proxying. Reproducer: internal repro created by Infra on 2026-03-06; billing lookup returned hosted rate when route metadata was 'hosted-edge-03' and did not include 'dedicated_contract:BC-RES-2026' header. Billing team: rate cache flush occurred during maintenance; stale rate_cache may have resulted in fallback to default hosted tariff for short window.

Additional findings: 1) Only 12.1k tokens billed as hosted — small relative to customer's monthly usage but significant due to unit price delta. 2) KV-cache warmup uses a separate 'probe' token classification that historically has been included in reserved allowance; reconciliation code paths diverge depending on 'origin_pool' vs 'effective_route'. 3) Linked issue SUP-314777 documents prior edge-case where prewarm probes were billed on hosted after private->hosted path change.

Pending items: billing to calculate credit if reconciliation confirms contract-level mapping should have applied; infra to add metadata preservation fix in proxy; postmortem to avoid recurrence for other dedicated customers.
comments: 2026-03-05 Nina Patel (Customer): Hi Support — we see a surprise $2.4k 'warmstart-probe-tokens' invoice line on our March invoice. We were on reserved capacity; please explain and reverse if this was misbilled.
2026-03-05 Support auto-reply: Thanks for the report. We have opened SUP-995555 and assigned an engineer. Estimated first response within SLA.

2026-03-06 Carlos Mendez (Support): Thanks Nina — can you confirm whether your dedicated pool had autoscaling enabled and if you were running a canary rollout on 2026-02-28? Any links to deploy IDs help.
2026-03-06 Nina Patel (Customer): Yes autoscaling enabled; canary deploy id: canary-20260227-8K. We saw degraded throughput and a fallback to hosted for ~90m during maintenance. Logs attached.

2026-03-07 Billing (Elena Rossi): Preliminary check: rate cache refresh was in progress during the window; we see postbacks that lacked contract resolution. We will compute provisional credit if engineering confirms bug. ETA 2026-03-09.

2026-03-08 Infra (Samir Gupta): Reproducer built. Found that proxy dropped X-Org-Contract header on cross-region proxy hop when route changed from 'dedicated' -> 'hosted'. Patch under review: proxy-preserve-contract-headers. Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/411.
2026-03-09 Billing (Elena Rossi): Calculated provisional credit for $2,438.70 pending confirmation. Need final approval after infra rollout and a full reconcile run.
2026-03-10 Carlos Mendez (Support): Notifying customer of provisional credit while infra patch rolls out. Will update when credit posts.
resolution: (in progress) Provisional credit prepared for full amount $2,438.70 pending final reconcile. Infra to deploy proxy header-preserve patch to prevent future occurrences. Follow-up: postmortem and automated alert when billing-rate-lookup returns default hosted tariff for a reserved-contract org. Finance will post credit to next invoice if reconcile confirms misbilling.
customer_impact_summary: Customer billed hosted-rate for warmstart traffic that should have been covered by reserved contract during a short hybrid fallback window. Financial impact: $2.4k unexpected charge; customer requests credit and assurance it won't recur.
next_steps: 1) Infra to deploy PR and verify header preservation in canary by 2026-03-11. 2) Billing to run full reconcile for 2026-02-28 window after patch verification. 3) Support to confirm credit posting and close ticket. 4) Postmortem write-up and runbook update (owner: Carlos).
